sequence.query_order: For each cohort copy dataset.queries and call random.Random(41061).shuffle exactly once; reuse that complete order for all four configurations, as the unchanged original helper does.
sequence.lifecycle: One persistent measurement worker for the complete two-cohort/eight-cell sequence. Build each cohort's fresh LM database once and retain the same MemoryBook across its four configurations. Tokenizer warmup, database creation and ingestion occur with the observer disabled. Do not split configurations into new processes or rebuild their database.
sequence.dataset_identity: Require the original frozen sessions/query counts, dataset fingerprints and query-order digests before calls. Download only the already-used pinned LoCoMo source; never select or decode fresh rows.

environment.interpretation: One hosted VM; instrumented mechanism spans only, no speed or memory comparison.

integer_encoding: Every nanosecond/count was parsed and summed with BigInt; exact JSON integer tokens are preserved.
evidence_scope: All eight standalone primary-cell gzip files and eight original C2 references were independently read, raw/compressed hash checked, and fully audited. The inaccessible monolithic copy was not independently read or proven equal.
interpretation: Partial instrumented native builtin boundaries only. Inclusive nesting may overlap. Exclusive spans still include callbacks, scheduling and observer effects. Residual is unattributed, never Python-only. Callback bookkeeping is separate and never subtracted. No comparison of these diagnostic times with uninstrumented engine performance.

audit_implementation.final_assembler_role: Metadata reconciliation and lossless aggregation of previously published raw-audited cell receipts; no changes to raw audit rules after results.
